Subject: MAP Draft & Load Test Scheduling

Thanks for the quick sync this morning — nice to meet the team. Quick recap and where we are on the MAP milestone for load/perf testing:

- Goal: Traffic replay of last-month production window to validate dedicated capacity and peak QPS handling.
- Target peak QPS (observed): ~1,200 TPS sustained for 10–15m, with spikes to ~1,800 TPS for short bursts.
- Proposed test window: week of Apr 5 (preferred Apr 6–8), 2-hour slot including warmup and peak replay.
- Dependencies from our side: DB snapshot and traffic export; security signing for the replay access; procurement approval for dedicated capacity demo.

Can Redwood provide a sizing estimate (nodes/GPU type), and confirm responsibilities/timeline in the MAP? I attached a sample traffic archive (production_traffic_sample.tar.gz) — it's a 30-minute window with metadata.

Thanks — I can loop in procurement if we need to lock dates.

Alex Moore
Director, SRE
Nimbus Analytics

Alex — great to meet you as well. Thanks for the sample and the clear recap. Per our call, I tailored the MAP draft to include the load test milestone and responsibilities; attaching MAP-Nimbus-v2.xlsx with proposed milestones and dates. High-level next steps from Redwood:

1) Tech validation call (30m) — to confirm replay format, auth, and timing. Proposed: Thu Mar 25, 10:00–10:30 PT.
2) Redwood sizing & runbook (deliverable) — we’ll provide a capacity_estimate.pdf and a replay runbook after we ingest the sample.
3) Schedule test window — target Apr 6 (backup Apr 8).
4) Test execution & results — Redwood provides monitoring dashboard and cost estimate for dedicated capacity.

Responsibilities (MAP excerpt):
- Nimbus: provide DB snapshot, traffic export, and a contact for replay orchestration; confirm blackout window.
- Redwood: validate sample, provide sizing recommendation, provision dedicated pool (if requested), and run test with joint ops.

Aditya/Vivek — can you confirm rough sizing assumptions and when we can deliver the capacity estimate? I marked a tentative MAP target close date of Apr 15 (open to adjust once test completes).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Load Test Scheduling

Marissa / Vivek — quick tech notes after a peek at the sample that Alex sent:

- Sample profile: 30m window looks representative. We should ask Nimbus to provide a 10m warmup + 30m peak segment if possible (total ~40m) to get steady-state KV cache behavior.
- Sizing (preliminary): to hit sustained 1,200 QPS with headroom for spikes to 1,800, estimate is 3–4 p3-equivalent GPU workers (or 4x A100-ish GPU nodes) with high network bandwidth. If they want headroom for scale tests, plan for 6 nodes for the stress run.
- Memory/kv cache: ensure each node has enough GPU RAM for longest sequence lengths (we assume 2–4k tokens).
- Storage / replay infra: recommend S3-hosted traces accessible from our test cluster and a short-lived IAM role for access.

I’ll draft capacity_estimate.pdf with assumptions (QPS mapping, per-node throughput, cost estimate) and aim to share by EOD Mon Mar 22. If we need to do an on-call window during the test, suggest we reserve Apr 6 08:00–12:00 PT.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Confirm the tech check on Thu Mar 25, 10:00 PT — I’ll invite our SRE (Samir Patel) and procurement if we need a date hold.
- Provide the 40-minute replay segment (10m warmup + 30m peak) and S3 share link by Tue Mar 30.
- Procurement will review the dedicated capacity quote once we get the capacity_estimate.pdf.

For the MAP, Apr 6 as primary test window works — we’ll keep Apr 8 as a backup. Target close date of Apr 15 is fine contingent on test outcomes.

One quick ask: can Redwood provide a short runbook (one-pager) listing the exact S3 object layout and IAM role permissions required? That’ll speed our infra team.

Alex
